description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing plugin configurations and activation states within the openclaw project, including normalization, resolution, and slot decision logic.

methods.name: normalizePluginsConfigWithResolver
methods.description: Normalizes plugin configuration with optional custom plugin ID normalization.

methods.name: resolveExplicitPluginSelection
methods.description: Determines if a plugin is explicitly enabled based on configuration, origin, and root config.

methods.name: resolvePluginActivationState
methods.description: Calculates the activation state of a plugin based on configuration, origin, and other parameters.

methods.name: hasExplicitPluginConfig
methods.description: Checks if the plugin configuration has explicit settings.

methods.name: resolveEnableState
methods.description: Simplifies plugin activation state to enabled/disabled with reason.

methods.name: isBundledChannelEnabledByChannelConfig
methods.description: Checks if a bundled channel plugin is enabled via channel configuration.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveEnableState
methods.description: Resolves the effective enable state considering all configuration layers.

methods.name: resolveEffectivePluginActivationState
methods.description: Returns the full plugin activation state considering all factors.

methods.name: resolveMemorySlotDecision
methods.description: Determines if a memory slot plugin should be enabled based on slot assignment and plugin kind.
